record.question: The advantage of patient counselling after giving their prescription is that:
options: There will be increased pharmacy revenue
It will lead to faster dispensing time
It will reduce the incidence of medication errors
record.explanation: Answer D: It will reduce the incidence of medication errors. Patient counseling can improve understanding and safe use and reduce medication errors. Reference: https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/WHO-EDM-PAR-2003.2. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
